annotation_policy.unit: Projected 2D outer silhouette, not physical object category. Approximately circular discs/coins are circle; quadrilateral cassette/floppy shells with mild chamfers are rectangle (including squares).
annotation_policy.exclude: Text, holes, spokes/slots, printed images and shadows inside an outer object are not separate targets. Elliptical projections are explicit distractors, not circle targets.
annotation_policy.coordinates: Integer xywh half-open in distributed image pixels; max side 800. Newly added photos max side 600.
annotation_policy.annotation_quality: Manual single-annotator boxes checked on coordinate grids before phase-4 inference. No pixel masks or second annotator. Occluded bboxes remain estimates in stress cases; clipped boxes use visible extent.
annotation_policy.scope: Basic complete approximately front-facing silhouettes evaluated separately from clipping/occlusion and negative frames. Overlapping circles remain unsupported stress targets; no promise of amodal reconstruction.

protocol.split_unit: Original source/capture family; same author series grouped conservatively. All derivatives inherit source group.
protocol.test_policy: All eight phase-3 test photos are now development. New phase-4 test photos/roles/labels fixed before any prediction. Freeze model and processing before accessing new test.
protocol.statistical_scope: Convenience sample of photographs and a few clearly marked scans, not a representative population benchmark.
